# SYNTHETIC Raven selection tables — NOT real annotations

Everything in this folder is invented test data. It does not come from the
biologists, and passing tests on it does **not** prove compatibility with their
real Raven Pro exports.

Files are generated by `generate_fixtures.py` (run it after editing). Every table
has a `Synthetic` column set to `SYNTHETIC-TEST-DATA`. The matching clip data
comes from `synthetic_clip_frame()` in the same script; no real partition is used.

| File | Encoding / line ends | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_ana_sequence_utf8.Table.1.selections.txt` | UTF-8 + BOM, CRLF | 2 views per selection; single / multiple clip overlap; gap; spanning a file boundary; missing label; End < Begin; unknown folder; views disagreeing; missing path; ambiguous recording |
| `SYNTHETIC_bostjan_sequence_cp1250.Table.1.selections.txt` | CP1250, LF | Second annotator labelling Ana's selections 1–3 differently; š/č/ž; different annotation column names |
| `20260320_185000.Table.1.selections.txt` | UTF-8, CRLF | Single-file export without file/path/offset columns; source file inferred from the table name (opt-in); selection past the 60 s end |
| `SYNTHETIC_filename_only.txt` | UTF-8, LF | `Begin File` only: the stem exists at two locations; decimal comma; malformed row |
| `SYNTHETIC_sequence_without_offset.txt` | UTF-8, LF | Sequence-relative times over two files without `File Offset (s)` |

## Checked against the first real delivery (2026-10, not stored here)

- Raven default headers; `Begin File` + `File Offset (s)` present; no `Begin Path` / `End File`;
  one view per selection; UTF-8 and CP1250 files; `.` decimals.
- Location and annotator come from the table name `<location>-<ID>[-hitro].txt` (`hitro` = quick pass).
- `Begin Time (s)` is batch-relative and unreliable; start = `File Offset (s)`, length = End − Begin.
- Many `Begin File` names drop the month's leading zero (`2026223_122000.WAV`); `Begin Date` confirms them.
- `Begin Clock Time` can differ from file-name time + offset by up to ~1 s.
- Some recordings are 55 s, not 60 s; header-only tables occur.

## Assumptions not covered by the real delivery

- Exact header names (`Begin Time (s)`, `File Offset (s)`, `Begin Path`, …) and whether
  the biologists enabled `Begin File` / `Begin Path` / `File Offset (s)`.
- That `File Offset (s)` is the start time within `Begin File` for sequence tables.
- One row per view per selection, with identical times across views.
- Encoding (UTF-8 vs CP1250/CP1252) and decimal separator.
- That the folder directly above the file in `Begin Path` is the Citimon location.
- Recording length of 60 s and channel 1 for all Citimon files.
- Whether annotators annotated the original WAVs or the MP3s (sample rate, channels).
